newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HANSAPANK LEADS SHARE MARKET ADVANCE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HANSAPANK LEADS SHARE MARKET ADVANCE.

text.p: Hansapank led the share market higher on Monday after its first quarter results were well-received although overall market trade was down.
The Talse rose by 2.98 percent to close on 267.60 kroons with 56.7 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
Hansapank turned over 28.1 million kroons of shares to dominate trade to end 10 kroons higher on 279.50 kroons after recording highs of 288.00 during the day.
"Hansapank's results were good but we are expecting a correction soon to bring the price back," another dealer said.
Hansapank said its first quarter consolidated profit was 136.1 million kroons.
Dealers said that share trade was hit in the morning when Hansapank and Hoiupank, the largest banks, were absent from the market due to technical problems.

"Looking ahead the market is expected to be stable to lower on Tuesday, although other banks are due to release their first quarter consolidated results soon and this may support prices for a short time longer," he added.
Total market capitalisation was higher at 14.30 billion kroons compared to Friday's 14.02 billion kroons.
Uhispank turned over 10.5 million kroons to gain 1.00 kroons to finish on 57.00 kroons.
"There was active foreign buying interest in Uhispank in Helsinki and this seemed to have supported the price, while Italian investors are still selling off their holding," one trader said.
On the over-the-counter market, total trade was a slow 4.9 million kroons of shares with diversified industrialist Norma the most active stock.
Norma traded 2.2 millions kroons of share to close 0.25 kroons higher on 75.80 kroons.
"Most of the trade in Norma was small deals, so it is more likely that local small investors are the most active in this stock," one trader said.
